notes: A single-thread LocalChannel (no locks) with send(v).await and receive().await. LocalChannel's buffer is a fixed array type, so the runtime capacity 16, 64 or 1024 selects the array size at compile time ([u64; 16], [u64; 64], [u64; 1024]). The four producers are joined with the consumer as futures of one task; nothing is spawned.
